guardFunctions.name: e1_guard_cash_capture_closed
guardFunctions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.e1_guard_cash_capture_closed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.forma_pago::text = 'EFECTIVO'
     AND NEW.naturaleza::text IN ('INGRESO_FISICO', 'DEVOLUCION_FISICA') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = 'E1C01',
      MESSAGE = 'E1: la captura física de efectivo de crédito está deshabilitada.';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

guardFunctions.name: e1_guard_historical_attribution_closed
guardFunctions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.e1_guard_historical_attribution_closed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING
    ERRCODE = 'E1A01',
    MESSAGE = 'E1: la atribución histórica de crédito está deshabilitada.';
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

guardTriggers.name: zz_e1_historical_attribution_closed
guardTriggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER zz_e1_historical_attribution_closed AFTER INSERT ON public.atribuciones_credito_e1 FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION e1_guard_historical_attribution_closed()
